caseName: Michigan Department of State Police v. Sitz
caseNameFull: Michigan Department of State Police v. Sitz

opinions.text: Ct. App. Mich. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 806.] Motion of Mothers Against Drunk Driving in Michigan for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae, for divided argument, and for additional time for oral argument denied. Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.
